The language is also known as ''Yirr-Thangell'' and ''Yirrk-Mel''. During the early 1900s (decade), Yirrk-Thangalkl speakers started [[language shift|shifting]] to the [[Yir-Yoront language|Yir-Yoront dialect]] with the arrival of the Mitchell River Mission.{{cite book | first = Barry | last = Alpher | year = 1991 | title = Yir-Yoront lexicon: Sketch and dictionary of an Australian language}} == Phonology == === Consonants === Yirrk-Thangalkl has 16 [[consonant]]s.
